_doc: Study hub content. Status values: Planned | In progress | Completed. 'date' is ISO (exact) or null; 'date_text' is shown when there is no exact date. Every milestone needs a source id; a public milestone's source must be citable publicly or a company record, never an instruction or a draft (content.py refuses the build otherwise). 'public': false keeps an item out of public pages. The summary fields also fill the programme brief PDF, so the study hub and the brief say the same. No percentages, recruitment counts, approvals or committee appointments may be added unless sourced.

summary.investigates: Whether {{fact:product.name}}, an investigational oral cannabidiol medicine, shows a dose response, changes symptoms, and is safe and tolerable in {{fact:phase2b.population}}.
summary.completed: Phase 1 study in {{fact:phase1.n}} healthy volunteers: completed {{fact:phase1.end}}; database locked {{fact:phase1.db_lock}}; analysis outputs delivered {{fact:phase1.outputs_delivered}}.
summary.next: Finalise the Phase 2B protocol, then submit it for regulatory and research ethics review. No date has been set.

design_sources.title: Population and aims
content: Population: people at clinical high risk of psychosis.
Aims: dose response, symptoms, safety and tolerability.

design_sources.title: CHR-P Phase 2B design document

phase1.text: Pre-specified stopping rules, including stopping if one participant had a serious reaction possibly related to the study medicine, or two had severe reactions.
No data monitoring committee was used.
Statistical outputs were produced by an external biostatistics provider under documented quality testing.

measured.absorption: How much cannabidiol and two of its breakdown products (7-hydroxy-CBD and 7-carboxy-CBD) reached the blood over time, and how quickly (pharmacokinetics).
measured.safety: Adverse events, blood and urine tests, vital signs, heart tracings (ECG), gut symptoms, and a structured suicidality questionnaire (C-SSRS).

can_establish: How NWPT-SM32300 is absorbed after single doses in healthy adults, compared with a licensed cannabidiol medicine.
Short-term safety and tolerability of single doses in healthy adults.
cannot_establish: Whether NWPT-SM32300 reduces symptoms or prevents psychosis in anyone.
Whether it is safe with repeated daily dosing, in young people, or in people at clinical high risk.
Whether it is bioequivalent to, or better tolerated than, another product: the study was small and not designed to show either.
Whether it reaches or acts on the brain.
phase1.results_review: Numerical results withheld until the CSR and plain-language wording are reconciled. When supplied, set results to {as_of, source, summary, table:[{measure, finding}] , limitations} and the page renders them without redesign.
